brief: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching.

requirements.requirement: One drawer and one spike at the very same corner of the same cell, touching
requirements.evidence: Build has spike:0#-1,0|-1,1|0,0 at junction -1,0/-1,1/0,0 and notch:0#-2,1#notch0 with stem hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf (drawer frame) at empty cell -2,1. They are not the same junction: find_sockets for spike offered only that junction, while the drawer-frame notch that shares two bases could only be placed at -2,1, a different corner. Configurator prevents co-location (SPIKE_CLASH / SOCKET_OCCUPIED for same junction) so touching co-location cannot be verified mesh-clear. check_build = clear but not for co-located requirement.

finish.summary: Spike placed but drawer frame is at a different corner; same-corner touching drawer+spike is blocked by placement rules and would cause mesh clash, so requirement is unmet and reported honestly per instructions.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
